good: Strong action hook—immediate UFC branding and dynamic fight footage captures attention in first frame
Clear narrative arc—fight → decision → championship celebration creates emotional payoff
On-screen graphics and text overlay (UFC branding, fighter names) maintain visual interest
Broad appeal to MMA and sports audiences with iconic championship moment
bad: 7-second average watch time is critically low—viewers drop off mid-video despite strong hook
Minimal saves (15)—no rewatch-worthy moment or aspirational content
Caption relies on fighter names and Portuguese—limits discoverability outside MMA/Brazilian audiences
No visible on-screen call-to-action (poll, text prompt, or engagement hook) to drive shares
reels.top_tip: Add fast-paced text overlays during victory moments (e.g., 'DECISION WIN', 'RETAINS TITLE') with quick cuts to hold viewers past the 7-second drop-off point—your hook works but the middle bleeds momentum before the payoff lands
